主要内容: After two painful years of restructuring, Jan Jenisch, the CEO of LafargeHolcim Ltd., believes the world's largest building materials maker is now ready for acquisitions again. However, he emphasized that any potential deals must not jeopardize the progress made so far. Jenisch was appointed to address the issues stemming from the failed merger of Lafarge SA and Holcim Ltd., which were former French and Swiss national champions that merged in 2015. The restructuring process has been challenging, but Jenisch is optimistic that the company is now in a position to explore strategic acquisitions without compromising its current progress.
